quote: It can be seen that ReinforceBug produces AEs with a comparatively high PCS (i.e., on average 74%), semantic similarity (i.e., on average 83.5%) ...

We defined three post constraints, i.e., the semantic similarity (calculated using Universal Sentence Encoder with ε = 0.60), spelling error rate (using Garbe), grammar error rate (using LanguageTool), and the model confidence score (PCS). We also measured perturbation rate (percentage of words changed) and success rate (proportion of utility‑preserving AEs).
the percentage of the spelling and grammatical errors should not be more than η and ι respectively, and the semantic similarity between the original and AE should be > ε.
